metadata.explanation: Task requires adding title 'Note' with right alignment to slide 2. Evaluator reads pptx from VM and checks title text and alignment with partial credit (0.5 each).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly targets slide 2 (index 1) and extracts both title text and alignment, matching the two instruction requirements.
Metric correctly handles expected as a rules dict (type='rule'), directly accessing expected.get('title_text') and expected.get('title_alignment') without incorrect nesting.
Expected values {'title_text': 'Note', 'title_alignment': 'RIGHT'} are semantically correct for the instruction.
Partial credit scoring (0.5 + 0.5) is appropriate for the two independent sub-goals.
Alignment is read from paragraphs[0].alignment.name, which returns 'RIGHT' when explicitly set via Ctrl+R, correctly distinguishing set vs unset alignment.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: The getter searches for shape by name 'PlaceHolder 1', which may not match all pptx title placeholder names. A more robust approach would also check placeholder_format.idx == 0 (title placeholder index) as the primary lookup, falling back to name or first text frame.
